ublock-origin.note: Bundle unmodified (Mozilla-signed). Build must pin version and verify sha256; update on each release.
ublock-origin.managed-lists: Klin's policy switches on fanboy-cookiemonster and ublock-cookies-easylist (downloaded, not bundled) and repeats the 1.76.0 default selection. Re-check config/policies/policies.json and tests/acceptance/cookie-banners on each uBlock Origin update.

greenweb.note: Mozilla-signed on addons.mozilla.org as unlisted (ADR 0004), unmodified. The .xpi is an asset of the v0.1.0 release of the greenweb repository; its sha256 was checked against the downloaded asset on 14 Nov 2026. The signature only removed the trailing newline of manifest.json; every other file is identical to the package built from greenweb main (73891056). Fetched at build time only; the browser makes no connection for it. Bundled by build/bundle-third-party.py.

sherlock-sites.note: Site list only (URL patterns and how to tell a profile exists), converted by build/gen-sherlock-sites.py into extensions/username-check/data/sites.json; Sherlock code is not used. Licence file kept next to the data. NSFW sites left out. Update by changing the pin deliberately.
